fusions.name: Studded Shoulder
fusions.desc: Drives a studded pauldron into the target. The blow deals 14 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung Rivets
fusions.desc: The burst deals 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Planted in Plate
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hobnailed Harness
fusions.desc: Conjures a harness of studded plate: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, 12% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your maximum health rises by 15.
